_note: Bars for tests/run_motion_tests.gd, the motion gate (D-177 'Motion first'). Every number was measured on origin/main 1f23937a (walk, 90/180 turns, turn from standing, held curve, 6 s each, seeded sim, 60 Hz) and set a small margin past the measured value; never widen a bar to get green, fix the motion. slide_max (units/s) and aloft_yaw_max (deg): measured 0.00 at every stage, bars sit just above zero. catch_straight: catch steps a second walking straight, measured 0, one step in the 5 s window is 0.2. catch_turn_smooth: the young croc's smooth turns (D-131), measured worst 1.00 (turn180), bar held at the 2026-10-23 lead ruling. steps_ratio_min/max: legs steps a second over the walk clip's authored pace, measured young 2.26, Behemoth 2.15, Colossus 1.75 (now set by D-302, see its own _note), bar about +-8%. step_tol: the sim's step vs half the clip's stride, measured 0.0% Behemoth, 0.2% Colossus. jerk_walk/jerk_turn: shin jerk p99 in deg/frame^2, measured walk 2.7/4.3/1.0, worst turn 4.83/6.95/5.36 (young/Behemoth/Colossus), bar about +15-20%. stretch_max: planted hip-ankle reach as a share of leg length, measured worst 0.93. pivot_max / centre_max: hip heights, measured worst 0.06 / 0.48 (the Behemoth turn90 with the D-187 heavy turn at uturn_s 1.94, 0.481; 0.42 on the old turn; a slower Behemoth turn raises it, 2.0 gives 0.506). lift_min/lift_max: the walk clip's toe-tip rise as a share of hip height, measured 3.8% / 2.1% / 2.0% (Colossus now set by D-302, its own _note); the young croc may bounce a little (lead 2026-10-23), the lower bar says the feet do lift.

Colossus._note: The Dracorex walk (D-302: 'a cycle of ~2.7 s (a step ~1.35 s, stride ~15 m)'; open sizes 'sit between today's croc and the sample'). steps_ratio: D-302's step, 0.741 steps a second over the clip's authored 0.75 (80-frame cycle), is 0.988x; the band keeps the old band's relative width (+-6.6%, old 1.62-1.85 at 1.75x). lift: no ruling, so the band runs from today's 2.4% to the sample's higher foot, measured on the Dracorex study (toe-tip rise over its cycle's highest hip: left 9.8%, right 13.0%; measurements only, study licence). Lead ruling 2026-10-27; old bars 1.62-1.85 and 0.015-0.024.
